postureCheckCertificate.description.rest: Restrict access to peers holding a certificate issued by your own certificate authority.
postureCheckCertificate.text.pleasePaste: Please paste a valid PEM encoded certificate
postureCheckCertificate.text.pasteThePEM: Paste the PEM encoded public certificate of the root or intermediate CA that issues your device certificates. Peers will only be allowed to connect if they hold a certificate issued by one of these CAs and prove possession of its private key.
postureCheckCertificate.text.thisCheckIs: This check is not supported on mobile devices. Peers running the NetBird iOS or Android app will always fail this check and be denied access.
postureCheckGeoLocation.description.rest: Restrict access in your network based on country or region.
postureCheckGeoLocation.text.thisCheckIn: This check includes GeoLite2 data created by MaxMind, available from
postureCheckGeoLocation.text.chooseWheth: Choose whether you want to allow or block access from specific countries or regions
postureCheckNetBirdVersion.description.r: Restrict access to peers with a specific NetBird client version.
postureCheckNetBirdVersion.text.pleaseEn: Please enter a valid version, e.g., 0.2, 0.2.0, 0.2.0-alpha.1
postureCheckNetBirdVersion.text.onlyPeer: Only peers with the minimum specified NetBird client version will have access to the network.
Restrict access in your network based on the operating system.
postureCheckOperatingSystem.text.chooseW: Choose whether you want to allow or block the operating system.
postureCheckOperatingSystem.helpText.use: Use a custom version number if you need more control.
postureCheckPeerNetworkRange.description: Restrict access by allowing or blocking peer network ranges.
postureCheckPeerNetworkRange.text.please: Please enter a valid CIDR, e.g., 192.168.1.0/24
postureCheckPeerNetworkRange.text.choose: Choose whether you want to allow or block specific peer network ranges
postureCheckProcess.description.restrict: Restrict access in your network based on running processes of a peer.
postureCheckProcess.text.pleaseEnterAVal: Please enter a valid macOS file path
Please enter a valid Unix file path
Please enter a valid Windows file path
postureCheckProcess.text.addThePathOfAn: Add the path of an executable file of the process. You can define a path for Linux, macOS and Windows. Peers will only be allowed to connect if the process is running on their system.
certificateTooltip.text.peersHoldingACer: peers holding a certificate issued by one of the following CAs
